verdict.rationale: Vercel documents its own firewall capability: blocking attacks, scrapers, and unwanted traffic with custom rules, IP blocking, and managed rulesets, plus invisible bot checks for sensitive routes. Nothing in the pack shows DDoS mitigation, or that either protection applies to every request by default. A community anecdote that undetected DDoS traffic can lead to large bills lowers confidence, but it does not contradict any documented claim. missing for 10: documented DDoS protection, evidence that the WAF/DDoS protection is on by default for every request, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can have DDoS protection and a web application firewall applied to every request by default

citations.quote: Block attacks, scrapers, and unwanted traffic with custom rules, IP blocking, and managed rulesets.
Protect sensitive routes from sophisticated bots with an invisible check instead of a CAPTCHA.
